574-1981-2415-4699.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-4699.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

719-6495-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-6495-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 3.
719-6495-6871-6879.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

333-2438-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2438-8207.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

265-1477-2073--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat.
265-1477-2073--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Extruder. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

34-141-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-3967.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-2292-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

618-728-4681.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

341-1170-1477-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Umori has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-1477-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5686-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5686-7422.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2111-4779-4981.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7888.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
2034-5003-7888.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fearsome Goblin Pair, adding {C}{C}.
When Fearsome Goblin Pair dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Fearsome Goblin Pair trigger, creating a 0/0 Goblin Army creature token and putting four +1/+1 counters on it
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Goblin Army, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Fearsome Goblin Pair from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

38-4640-5149--168.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Goblin Samurai, adding {R}.
When the Goblin Samurai dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning the Goblin Samurai from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Oathkeeper's equip ability by paying {1} due to Power Artifact, attaching it to the Goblin Samurai.
Repeat.

757-2085-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

527-542-4742.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-2459-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Rograkh enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4186-4321-6824-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4321-6824-6890.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

826-1238-2351-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken until end of turn.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4404-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Corridor Monitor.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Corridor Monitor token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1645-5921-5954-6763.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

851-2457-4289-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

413-2281-6598.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting General Leo Cristophe.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing General Leo Cristophe.
When General Leo Cristophe dies, Saffi triggers, returning General Leo Cristophe from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When General Leo Cristophe enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the General Leo Cristophe trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat.

2743-4493-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Irenicus's Vile Duplication and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Irenicus's Vile Duplication copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2034-2741-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-2741-3490-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Essence Warden indestructible.
2034-2741-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

3885-6185-6280.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in hand.
3885-6185-6280.description:
Activate Stinkweed Imp's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it, causing you to mill a number of cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.

2061-3277-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2061-3277-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1849-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1849-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-2034-5263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

864-1799-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding one mana of any color.
When Eternal Witness dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Eternal Witness from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Eternal Witness from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

1185-1912-5140.notablePrerequisites: Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
1185-1912-5140.description:
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Kenrith's third ability by paying {W}, causing you to gain five life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting five ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

950-3069-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
950-3069-4050.description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Fatestitcher's unearth ability by paying {U}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste until end of turn.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fatestitcher, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to exile Fatestitcher using Void Maw's replacement effect instead of Fatestitcher's.
Activate Void Maw by putting Fatestitcher from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

313-325-1742-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four cards in hand.
313-325-1742-2034.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz triggers, exiling the discarded card.
Repeat from step 1 until you have an empty hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toluz, adding {C}{C}.
Toluz dies, returning all cards exiled with it to your hand.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Toluz from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Toluz enters the battlefield, causing it to connive.
Repeat.
